droid.notes: Devin bridge caps swe-2 at two concurrent calls, so Droid never runs wider than two trials.

amp.notes: Amp takes --model <route> and --effort <level>; no plugin and no mode label.

claude.notes: Traffic goes through the Devin policy shim on 20140 so Devin accepts the request.

codex.notes: OpenAI Codex CLI over 9Router's Responses endpoint. Effort lives in the 9Router route id. Devin routes go through the policy shim on 20140; other upstreams do not need it.
